name: Team
overview: Scripture highlights the vital importance of unity and collaboration within a team, emphasizing that brethren dwelling together in unity is both good and pleasant. The wisdom of many counselors brings safety and strength, as iron sharpens iron and two working together yield better results than one alone. Jesus demonstrated teamwork by sending his disciples out in pairs, and Paul describes the church as a body joined and knit together, each part contributing to the growth and edification of the whole in love.
